units: percent; x,width,tracking -> canvas width; y,height -> canvas height
font_status: Google Fonts substitutes retained from the supplied 8x10 specification; these exact families are used in the 5x7 previews.
tracking_status: Explicit additional tracking used in the rendered previews.

measurement_notes.boxes: center_x, center_y, width and visible_height describe actual visible ink in the sample preview, excluding transparent source padding. All layout values are percentages of their respective canvas axis.
measurement_notes.type_size: font_size_percent_height is the font em size as a percentage of canvas height; it is not visible_height. px = value * canvas_height / 100.
measurement_notes.tracking: additional_tracking_percent_width is extra spacing per character gap; px = value * canvas_width / 100. Standard font kerning also applies.
measurement_notes.autofit: max_width and max_visible_height are layout limits, not the measured sample width. For replacement names use the same size for both, chosen to fit the wider name. Keep centered.
measurement_notes.symbols: Use supplied original alpha, trim only fully transparent edge padding, uniform scale with contain inside fit_box_width/fit_box_height. Never force width and visible_height independently for a different pair.
measurement_notes.compatibility: Original top-level designs/elements and original element property names are retained. source_horizontal_to_4x5_factor is a legacy key set to 1 because these coordinates are already on the final 5x7 canvas; do not apply a second horizontal correction. Additional fields are implementation metadata.
measurement_notes.backgrounds: B includes continuous texture and peripheral ornaments only. No typography or zodiac symbols. Background decoration is allowed to bleed outside the safe text/symbol area.
measurement_notes.removed_dividers: Present only for Starlit and Timeless. These lower rules and small four-point star are absent from B and restored in A. The large upper ornamental stars/orbits already belong to B. Do not add them again.
measurement_notes.appearance: All metallic, paper-layer and relief appearances are printed visual effects on a flat card.
measurement_notes.resolution: Native generated backgrounds are 1060x1484 pixels. Deliverables are resampled to 1500x2100. Typography and original symbol overlays are rendered at the final canvas size.
